speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I need to ask you a few questions to understand your 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. Please tell me, how old are you and have you noticed any bone swelling or skin rashes?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of fever, easy bruising, severe leg pain (suggestive of marrow expansion), and age 4 is highly characteristic; confirm with a complete blood count (CBC) with peripheral smear and urgent bone marrow biopsy.
